## Which skill

Path to the SKILL.md, with line number if relevant:

`<skill-name>/SKILL.md:NNN`

## What is wrong

Describe the issue. If a command does not work, paste the command and the error.

```
# command + output here
```

## Why it matters

What does a reader following this advice get wrong, and what is the consequence?

## Suggested fix

If you have one. Otherwise skip — the maintainers will propose one.
